annotations.title: Get a CI run's status tree

description: Get a Depot CI run's status with its nested workflows, jobs and attempts (ids, keys, statuses, error messages). This is how to find the workflowId / jobId / attemptId for the log, diagnosis and retry tools. Depot: CIService/GetRunStatus.
name: depot_ci_get_run_status
title: Get a CI run's status tree
